steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have actually been changed.
Keep your foot off the brake and press ENGINE START/STOP so the ignition is in ON/RUN. Do not start the engine.
Slowly push the accelerator pedal all the way to the floor and let it up, three times, all within 10 seconds.
Keep your foot off the brake and press ENGINE START/STOP once to switch the ignition off.
Start the engine. If the oil change message still shows, the reset did not take.
oil.note: The manual says that if the message is still there after this, a dealer should reset the oil life.
